entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Representative.
Connecting you now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Yes, please provide the order number.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault. Frankly, the thing is garbage. The heart rate reading is completely inaccurate during my runs. It jumps from 90 to 160 for no reason.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the heart rate accuracy. We do have a technical support team that can walk you through a recalibration process. That usually solves the issue.
Listen, I appreciate the offer, but I don't have time for that. I've lost confidence in the product. At this point, I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand your position. You'd prefer not to troubleshoot and just proceed with a return. Let me just check our current return policy for this item. Please hold for a moment.
Okay.

Thank you for waiting. Alright, I've pulled up the policy. I can see the item was delivered 22 days ago, and our system shows that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you're well within the window.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So, we can process the return then?

Yes, absolutely. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just pack the device in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off.
Perfect, that's exactly what I needed. Thank you for making that easy.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
